f.title: Have a person responsible for pharmacovigilance when applying for a marketing authorisation
f.statement: An applicant for a marketing authorisation must also have a person responsible for pharmacovigilance, who may be employed or otherwise engaged by the marketing authorisation holder.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation applicant/holder
rows.quote: Podnosilac zahtjeva iz stava 1 ovog člana mora da ima i lice odgovorno za farmakovigilancu. Lice odgovorno za farmakovigilancu može biti zaposleno ili na drugi način angažovano kod nosioca dozvole za lijek.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The applicant referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article must also have a person responsible for pharmacovigilance. The person responsible for pharmacovigilance may be employed or otherwise engaged by the marketing authorisation holder.

f.title: Ensure the PV responsible person is qualified, trained, available 24 hours and resident in Montenegro
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance must hold a degree in pharmacy, medicine, dentistry or veterinary medicine, have proof of appropriate pharmacovigilance training, be available 24 hours a day and be resident in Montenegro.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation applicant/holder
rows.quote: Lice odgovorno za farmakovigilancu mora da ima završen farmaceutski, medicinski, stomatološki ili veterinarski fakultet, dokaz o odgovarajućoj edukaciji u oblasti farmakovigilance, mora biti dostupno 24 časa i imati prebivalište u Crnoj Gori.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance must have completed a faculty of pharmacy, medicine, dentistry or veterinary medicine, have proof of appropriate education in the field of pharmacovigilance, must be available 24 hours and have residence in Montenegro.

f.title: Include a PV system summary (QPPV evidence, contacts, PSMF location) and an RMP in the MA application
f.statement: The marketing authorisation application includes a summary of the applicant's pharmacovigilance system containing: proof that it employs or otherwise engages a person responsible for pharmacovigilance; that person's contact details; a statement that it has the means to fulfil pharmacovigilance tasks and responsibilities under the law; and the address/location where the PSMF is kept. It also includes the RMP describing the risk management system the applicant will introduce for the product, with a summary.
f.topic: PV system summary and RMP in the dossier
f.processes: PSMF management; Risk management & minimisation; Submission operations

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation applicant
rows.quote: sažetak sistema farmakovigilance podnosioca zahtjeva koji sadrži: - dokaz da ima zaposleno ili na drugi način angažovano lice odgovorno za farmakovigilancu, - kontakt podatke lica odgovornog za farmakovigilancu. - izjavu kojom potvrđuje da je obezbijedio uslove za ispunjavanje zadataka i odgovornosti farmakovigilance u skladu sa ovim zakonom, - adresu, odnosno mjesto gdje se čuva PSMF; 13) RMP sa opisom RMS koji će podnosilac zahtjeva uvesti za taj lijek, zajedno sa sažetkom plana;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: a summary of the applicant's pharmacovigilance system containing: - proof that it has employed or otherwise engaged a person responsible for pharmacovigilance, - contact details of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance, - a statement confirming that it has ensured the conditions for fulfilling pharmacovigilance tasks and responsibilities in accordance with this law, - the address or place where the PSMF is kept; 13) the RMP with a description of the RMS which the applicant will introduce for that medicine, together with a summary of the plan;

f.title: Include all MA conditions, special circumstances and obligations in the risk management system
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder must include in the risk management system all conditions, special circumstances and obligations from marketing authorisations granted under Articles 56 to 59 (conditional, exceptional-circumstances and conditioned authorisations).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da uključi u RMS sve uslove, posebne okolnosti i obaveze iz dozvola za lijek iz čl. 56 do 59 ovog zakona.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to include in the RMS all conditions, special circumstances and obligations from the marketing authorisations referred to in Articles 56 to 59 of this law.

f.title: Update the RMS when an imposed PASS or efficacy study obligation is confirmed
f.statement: Where the Institute confirms an obligation imposed after authorisation to conduct a PASS or post-authorisation efficacy study (after the holder's objection procedure) and amends the MA to include it as a condition, the marketing authorisation holder must update the risk management system.
f.exceptions: The MAH may, within 30 days of receiving the act imposing the obligation, ask to submit a written objection.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: U slučaju iz stava 5 ovog člana, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da ažurira RMS.
rows.review_note: Review: context (imposed PASS/PAES, 30-day objection right) taken from the same article. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: In the case referred to in paragraph 5 of this Article, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to update the RMS.

f.title: Report without delay any new information that may change the MA particulars or dossier
f.statement: After the marketing authorisation is granted, the holder must without delay submit to the Institute any new information that could lead to changes in the data or documentation under this law.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: Without delay
rows.quote: bez odlaganja, dostavi Institutu svaku novu informaciju koja može da dovede do izmjene podataka ili dokumentacije u skladu sa ovim zakonom;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: without delay, submit to the Institute any new information which may lead to a change of the data or documentation in accordance with this law;

f.title: Notify the Institute without delay of foreign bans or restrictions and any new benefit-risk information
f.statement: The holder must without delay inform the Institute of all prohibitions and restrictions imposed by competent authorities in any country where the medicine is marketed and of any other new information that may influence the benefit-risk assessment, including positive and negative results of clinical trials or other studies in all indications and populations (authorised or not) and data on use outside the terms of the marketing authorisation.
f.topic: Foreign regulatory actions and new B/R data
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Regulatory intelligence; Submission operations

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: Without delay
rows.quote: bez odlaganja, obavijesti Institut o svim mjerama zabrane i ograničenja koje su uvela nadležna tijela u bilo kojoj državi u kojoj je lijek stavljen u promet i o svim drugim novim informacijama koje mogu uticati na procjenu odnosa koristi i rizika primjene tog lijeka, uključujući i pozitivne i negativne rezultate kliničkih ispitivanja ili drugih studija za sve indikacije i populacije, bez obzira na to da li su uključene u dozvolu za lijek, kao i podatke o upotrebi lijeka kad takva upotreba nije sadržana u dozvoli za lijek;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: without delay, inform the Institute of all prohibition and restriction measures introduced by the competent bodies in any country in which the medicine is placed on the market and of all other new information which may influence the assessment of the benefit-risk balance of that medicine, including both positive and negative results of clinical trials or other studies in all indications and populations, whether or not included in the marketing authorisation, as well as data on the use of the medicine where such use is outside the terms of the marketing authorisation;

f.title: Keep product information up to date with current scientific knowledge and EU recommendations
f.statement: The holder must ensure that product information is kept up to date with the latest scientific knowledge, including conclusions of assessments and recommendations published in the European Union.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: obezbijedi da se informacije o lijeku ažuriraju u skladu sa najnovijim naučnim saznanjima, uključujući zaključke procjena i preporuke objavljene u Evropskoj uniji;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: ensure that the information on the medicine is updated in accordance with the latest scientific knowledge, including conclusions of assessments and recommendations published in the European Union;

f.title: Provide data showing the benefit-risk balance remains positive, without delay and in full
f.statement: For continuous benefit-risk evaluation, the holder must submit to the Institute, without delay and in full, data demonstrating that the benefit-risk balance remains positive.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: Without delay
rows.quote: bez odlaganja i u potpunosti, Institutu dostavi podatke koji pokazuju da odnos koristi i rizika ostaje pozitivan, radi kontinuirane procjene odnosa koristi i rizika;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: without delay and in full, submit to the Institute data showing that the benefit-risk balance remains positive, for the purpose of continuous assessment of the benefit-risk balance;

f.title: Provide a copy of the PSMF within 7 days of the Institute's request
f.statement: The holder must submit a copy of the pharmacovigilance system master file (PSMF) to the Institute whenever requested, within seven days of receipt of the request.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 7 days from receipt of the request
rows.quote: dostavi Institutu kopiju PSMF kad god to Institut zahtijeva, u roku od sedam dana od dana prijema zahtjeva.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: submit to the Institute a copy of the PSMF whenever the Institute so requests, within seven days from the day of receipt of the request.

deadline_rule.applies_to: PSMF copy requested by the Institute

f.title: Provide consumption and prescription-volume data on request, notably for pharmacovigilance
f.statement: At the Institute's request, in particular in relation to pharmacovigilance, the holder must submit all data on consumption of the medicine and all data it holds on the volume of prescriptions.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Na zahtjev Instituta, a naročito u odnosu na farmakovigilancu, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da dostavi sve podatke o potrošnji lijeka, kao i sve podatke kojima raspolaže, a koji se odnose na obim propisivanja lijeka.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: At the request of the Institute, and in particular in relation to pharmacovigilance, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit all data on the consumption of the medicine, as well as all data at its disposal relating to the volume of prescription of the medicine.

f.title: Submit PSURs for a conditional MA on request or at least every six months
f.statement: At the Institute's request, without delay, or at the latest every six months from the grant or renewal of a conditional marketing authorisation, the holder must submit a PSUR.

rows.actor: Holder of a conditional marketing authorisation
rows.deadline: Without delay on request, or at least every six months from grant/renewal
rows.quote: Na zahtjev Instituta, bez odlaganja ili najkasnije svakih šest mjeseci od dana izdavanja, odnosno obnavljanja uslovne dozvole za lijek, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da podnese PSUR.
rows.review_note: Review: recurring six-monthly duty; no single fixed clock, so no deadline_rule. Breach is an offence under Art 347(1)(2). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: At the request of the Institute, without delay, or at the latest every six months from the day of issuing or renewal of the conditional marketing authorisation, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit a PSUR.

f.title: Operate the pharmacovigilance system in line with the law and GVP guidelines
f.statement: The Institute and the marketing authorisation holder operate a pharmacovigilance system in accordance with this law; the systems are operated in accordance with the GVP guidelines, which the Institute publishes on its website.
f.clause: VII. Farmakovigilanca ljekova za humanu upotrebu, Član 146

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Institut i nosilac dozvole za lijek vode sistem farmakovigilance u skladu sa ovim zakonom. Sistemi iz stava 1 ovog člana vode se u skladu sa GVP smjernicama.
rows.location: VII. Farmakovigilanca ljekova za humanu upotrebu, Član 146
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The Institute and the marketing authorisation holder operate the pharmacovigilance system in accordance with this law. The systems referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article are operated in accordance with the GVP guidelines.

f.title: Use the PV system for scientific evaluation of all information and risk minimisation
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder must operate a pharmacovigilance system through which it scientifically evaluates all information, considers options for minimising and preventing risks and takes appropriate measures.
f.processes: Signal management; Benefit–risk review; Safety governance

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: vodi sistem farmakovigilance pomoću kojeg vrši naučnu procjenu svih informacija, razmatra mogućnosti za minimizaciju i sprečavanje rizika i preduzima odgovarajuće mjere;
rows.review_note: Review: breach is an offence under Art 347(1)(48). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: operate a pharmacovigilance system by means of which it performs a scientific evaluation of all information, considers options for minimising and preventing risks and takes appropriate measures;

f.title: Audit the PV system regularly, record main findings in the PSMF and implement corrective actions
f.statement: The holder must regularly audit (check) its pharmacovigilance system, enter a note of the main findings in the PSMF and, based on them, ensure that an appropriate corrective action plan is prepared and implemented. The note may be removed once the corrective actions have been fully implemented.
f.clause: Član 153, stav 8 (see also Član 152, stav 1, tačka 2)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da redovno sprovodi reviziju svog sistema farmakovigilance i da u PSMF unese zabilješku o glavnim nalazima revizije, kao i da, na osnovu tih nalaza, obezbijedi izradu i sprovođenje odgovarajućeg plana korektivnih mjera
rows.location: Član 153, stav 8 (see also Član 152, stav 1, tačka 2)
rows.review_note: Review: Art 152(1)(2) states the same duty ('redovnu kontrolu'); merged into one row. Breach is an offence under Art 347(1)(49). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to regularly audit its pharmacovigilance system and to enter in the PSMF a note on the main findings of the audit, and, on the basis of those findings, to ensure the preparation and implementation of an appropriate corrective action plan

f.title: Ensure the PV responsible person is permanently and continuously available
f.statement: Within its pharmacovigilance system, the holder ensures that the person responsible for pharmacovigilance (Art 33) is permanently and continuously available. The person responsible for pharmacovigilance is responsible for establishing and maintaining the pharmacovigilance system in Montenegro.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: obezbjeđuje da je lice odgovorno za farmakovigilancu, iz člana 33 st. 5, 6 i 7 ovog zakona, stalno i u kontinuitetu dostupno;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: ensures that the person responsible for pharmacovigilance referred to in Article 33 paragraphs 5, 6 and 7 of this law is permanently and continuously available;

f.title: Ensure an EU QPPV is continuously available and notify the Institute and EMA of the EU QPPV
f.statement: The holder ensures that the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in the European Union is permanently and continuously available; that person must reside and operate in the EU, may also be the Montenegrin QPPV, and the holder must provide the Institute and EMA with the EU QPPV's name and contact details. Applies only from Montenegro's accession to the EU (Art 358).
f.applicability: From EU accession (Art 358 lists Art 153(1)(2) and (3))

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: obezbjeđuje da lice odgovorno za farmakovigilancu u Evropskoj uniji bude stalno i u kontinuitetu dostupno;
rows.review_note: Review: deferred application under Art 358 noted in applicability. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: ensures that the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in the European Union is permanently and continuously available;

f.title: Maintain the PSMF and make it available on request
f.statement: The holder maintains the PSMF and makes it available at the Institute's request.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: održava i na zahtjev Instituta čini dostupnim PSMF;
rows.review_note: Review: breach is an offence under Art 347(1)(50). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: maintains the PSMF and makes it available at the request of the Institute;

f.title: Operate a risk management system for each medicine
f.statement: The holder operates a risk management system (RMS) for each medicine.
f.exceptions: Not required for products authorised in the EU before 21 July 2012 unless the Institute imposes it (Art 154).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: sprovodi RMS za svaki lijek;
rows.review_note: Review: short quote is the whole point. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: operates an RMS for each medicine;

f.title: Monitor the outcome of risk minimisation measures in the RMP or MA conditions
f.statement: The holder monitors the outcome of risk minimisation measures contained in the RMP or set as conditions of a conditional MA, an MA under exceptional circumstances or an MA granted with obligations.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: prati ishod mjera za minimizaciju rizika koje su sadržane u RMP ili koje su određene kao uslovi u uslovnoj dozvoli za lijek, dozvoli pod posebnim okolnostima ili dozvoli za lijek izdatoj sa obavezama u skladu sa ovim zakonom;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: monitors the outcome of risk minimisation measures which are contained in the RMP or which are set as conditions in the conditional marketing authorisation, the marketing authorisation under exceptional circumstances or the marketing authorisation issued with obligations in accordance with this law;

f.title: Update the RMS and monitor PV data for new or changed risks and benefit-risk changes
f.statement: The holder updates the risk management system and monitors pharmacovigilance data to determine whether there are new risks, whether risks have changed, or whether there are changes in the benefit-risk balance.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: ažurira RMS i prati podatke farmakovigilance da bi se utvrdilo da li postoje novi rizici, da li su se rizici promijenili ili da li postoje promjene u odnosu koristi i rizika prilikom primjene ljekova.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: updates the RMS and monitors pharmacovigilance data in order to determine whether there are new risks, whether risks have changed or whether there are changes in the benefit-risk balance in the use of medicines.

f.title: Retain full responsibility for the PSMF and PV obligations when outsourcing PV tasks
f.statement: The holder may contract out certain pharmacovigilance tasks, including those of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance, to a separate legal entity in accordance with the GVP guidelines; in that case the holder remains responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the PSMF and for fulfilling its pharmacovigilance obligations.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Pojedine poslove farmakovigilance, uključujući i poslove lica odgovornog za farmakovigilancu, nosilac dozvole za lijek može ugovorom povjeriti posebnom pravnom licu, u skladu sa GVP smjernicama. U slučaju iz stava 6 ovog člana, nosilac dozvole za lijek ne oslobađa se odgovornosti za tačnost i potpunost PSMF, kao i za ispunjavanje obaveza iz sistema farmakovigilance.
rows.review_note: Review: level Permitted for outsourcing ('može'); the retained responsibility is mandatory and kept as part of the row. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder may by contract entrust certain pharmacovigilance tasks, including the tasks of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance, to a separate legal entity, in accordance with the GVP guidelines. In the case referred to in paragraph 6 of this Article, the marketing authorisation holder is not released from responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of the PSMF and for the fulfilment of the obligations of the pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: Implement an RMS for a pre-July-2012 product when the Institute imposes it, and file a variation
f.statement: For products authorised in the EU before 21 July 2012 the holder need not operate an RMS for each product, but the Institute may require it where there are concerns about risks affecting the benefit-risk balance, and may require a detailed RMS description within a set deadline. The holder may comment in writing within 30 days of the request. If the Institute confirms the obligation, the holder must fulfil it and submit a variation to include the RMS measures as a condition of the MA.
f.applicability: Products authorised in the EU before 21 July 2012

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Ako Institut potvrdi obavezu iz st. 2 i 3 ovog člana, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da tu obavezu ispuni i da podnese zahtjev za varijaciju kako bi se u dozvolu za lijek uključile mjere koje će preduzeti kao dio RMS, kao uslov.
rows.review_note: Review: context (exemption, 30-day comment window) summarised from the same article. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the Institute confirms the obligation referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to fulfil that obligation and to submit an application for a variation so that the measures it will take as part of the RMS are included in the marketing authorisation as a condition.

f.title: Inform the Institute before or when making public pharmacovigilance announcements, objectively
f.statement: If the holder intends to make public information on pharmacovigilance concerns relating to the use of a medicine, it must inform the Institute at the same time as or before publication, and must ensure that the information is presented objectively and is not misleading. (Submission to EMA and the European Commission before publication applies from EU accession.)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: At the latest at the time of publication
rows.quote: Ako nosilac dozvole za lijek namjerava da javno objavi informacije o farmakovigilanci u vezi sa primjenom lijeka, dužan je da o tome obavijesti Institut istovremeno ili prije njihovog objavljivanja. Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da obezbijedi da informacije iz stava 1 ovog člana budu prikazane objektivno i da ne dovode u zabludu.
rows.review_note: Review: Art 155(3) (prior submission to EMA/EC) applies only from EU accession (Art 358). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the marketing authorisation holder intends to make public information on pharmacovigilance related to the use of a medicine, it is obliged to inform the Institute thereof at the same time as or before their publication. The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to ensure that the information referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is presented objectively and is not misleading.

f.title: Record all suspected ADRs in Montenegro, spontaneous or from post-authorisation studies
f.statement: The holder must keep records of all suspected adverse reactions in Montenegro reported spontaneously by patients or health professionals or recorded during post-authorisation studies of the medicine.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: vodi evidenciju o svim sumnjama na neželjena dejstva lijeka u Crnoj Gori, prijavljena spontano od strane pacijenata ili zdravstvenih radnika ili zabilježena tokom ispitivanja lijeka nakon dobijanja dozvole za lijek;
rows.review_note: Review: breach is an offence under Art 347(1)(54). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: keep records of all suspected adverse reactions to the medicine in Montenegro, reported spontaneously by patients or health professionals or recorded during studies of the medicine after obtaining the marketing authorisation;

f.title: Collect and promptly submit all information that may affect the benefit-risk assessment
f.statement: The holder must monitor and collect all information that may affect the benefit-risk assessment of the medicine and submit it to the Institute without delay, as soon as possible.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: Without delay, as soon as possible
rows.quote: prati i prikuplja sve informacije koje mogu da utiču na procjenu odnosa koristi i rizika lijeka i da ih dostavi Institutu bez odlaganja, u što je moguće kraćem roku;
rows.review_note: Review: breach is an offence under Art 347(1)(55). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: monitor and collect all information which may affect the assessment of the benefit-risk balance of the medicine and submit it to the Institute without delay, in the shortest possible time;

f.title: Until EudraVigilance entry is available, forward serious domestic ADR reports within 15 days
f.statement: Until reports can be entered into the EudraVigilance database, the holder forwards to the Institute every report it receives of a suspected serious adverse reaction occurring in Montenegro, within 15 days of receipt of the report.
f.applicability: Serious suspected ADRs occurring in Montenegro, until EudraVigilance entry functionality is established

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 15 days from receipt of the report
rows.quote: do uspostavljanja funkcionalnosti unosa prijave u bazu podataka EudraVigilance, prosleđuje Institutu svaku primljenu prijavu sumnje na ozbiljno neželjeno dejstvo lijeka koje je ispoljeno na teritoriji Crne Gore, u roku od 15 dana od dana prijema te prijave:
rows.review_note: Review: interim national route; Art 157 EudraVigilance reporting applies only from EU accession. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: until the functionality of entering reports into the EudraVigilance database is established, forward to the Institute every received report of a suspected serious adverse reaction to the medicine which occurred in the territory of Montenegro, within 15 days from the day of receipt of that report;

deadline_rule.applies_to: serious suspected ADRs occurring in Montenegro (interim, until EudraVigilance entry)

f.title: Until EudraVigilance entry is available, submit non-serious domestic ADR reports within 90 days
f.statement: Until reports can be entered into EudraVigilance, the holder submits to the Institute reports of suspected non-serious adverse reactions occurring in Montenegro within 90 days of receipt of the report.
f.applicability: Non-serious suspected ADRs occurring in Montenegro, until EudraVigilance entry functionality is established

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 90 days from receipt of the report
rows.quote: do uspostavljanja funkcionalnosti unosa prijave u bazu podataka EudraVigilance, dostavlja Institutu prijavu sumnje na neželjeno dejstvo lijeka koje je ispoljeno na teritoriji Crne Gore, koje nije ozbiljnog karaktera, u roku od 90 dana od dana prijema te prijave;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: until the functionality of entering reports into the EudraVigilance database is established, submit to the Institute the report of a suspected adverse reaction to the medicine which occurred in the territory of Montenegro and which is not of a serious character, within 90 days from the day of receipt of that report;

deadline_rule.applies_to: non-serious suspected ADRs occurring in Montenegro (interim)

f.title: Have a procedure to obtain accurate, verifiable case data and submit follow-up information
f.statement: The holder must establish a procedure for obtaining accurate and verifiable data for the scientific evaluation of suspected adverse reaction reports, collect follow-up information on the case and submit it to the Institute (until EudraVigilance entry is available; thereafter to EudraVigilance under Art 157).
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: uspostavi proceduru za dobijanje tačnih i provjerljivih podataka za naučnu procjenu prijava sumnji na neželjena dejstva ljekova iz tač. 3 i 4 ovog stava, kao i da prikuplja dodatne informacije o slučaju i dostavlja ih Institutu, do uspostavljanja funkcionalnosti unosa prijave u bazu podataka EudraVigilance;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: establish a procedure for obtaining accurate and verifiable data for the scientific evaluation of reports of suspected adverse reactions referred to in points 3 and 4 of this paragraph, and collect additional information on the case and submit it to the Institute, until the functionality of entering reports into the EudraVigilance database is established;

f.title: On request, submit serious unexpected ADRs from the EU or third countries within 15 days
f.statement: Until EudraVigilance entry is available, at the Institute's request the holder submits reported cases of suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions occurring in the EU or a third country, within 15 days of receipt of the request.
f.applicability: Serious unexpected ADRs from the EU or third countries; on request; interim

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 15 days from receipt of the request
rows.quote: do uspostavljanja funkcionalnosti unosa prijave u bazu podataka EudraVigilance, na zahtjev Instituta dostavi prijavljene slučajeve sumnji na ozbiljna i neočekivana neželjena dejstva lijeka koja su ispoljena na teritoriji Evropske unije ili neke treće države, u roku od 15 dana od dana prijema zahtjeva;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: until the functionality of entering reports into the EudraVigilance database is established, at the request of the Institute submit the reported cases of suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions to the medicine which occurred in the territory of the European Union or a third country, within 15 days from the day of receipt of the request;

deadline_rule.applies_to: serious unexpected ADRs from the EU or third countries, on request (interim)

f.title: Record and report trial-related suspected reactions under the clinical-trial rules
f.statement: By way of exception to the duty to record ADRs from the EU and third countries, suspected adverse reactions occurring within a clinical trial are recorded and reported in accordance with Article 193 (SUSAR reporting).
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Izuzetno od stava 1 tačka 7 ovog člana, sumnje na neželjena dejstva u okviru kliničkog ispitivanja evidentiraju se i prijavljuju u skladu sa članom 193 ovog zakona.
rows.review_note: Review: routing rule between marketed and clinical reporting. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: By way of exception to paragraph 1 point 7 of this Article, suspected adverse reactions within a clinical trial are recorded and reported in accordance with Article 193 of this law.

f.title: Wholesalers: take over ADR duties for medicines marketed without an MA in Montenegro
f.statement: For a medicine on the market in Montenegro without a marketing authorisation (imported with import approval), the obligations of Article 156(1) points 2 to 5 are taken over by the wholesaler that was granted the import approval. (Applies until EU accession, Art 357.)
f.applicability: Medicines marketed in Montenegro without a marketing authorisation; until EU accession (Art 357)
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Wholesaler holding an import approval (veleprodaja kojoj je data saglasnost za uvoz)
rows.quote: Za lijek koji se nalazi u prometu u Crnoj Gori, a za koji nije izdata dozvola za lijek, obaveze iz stava 1 tač. 2 do 5 ovog člana preuzima veleprodaja kojoj je data saglasnost za uvoz.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For a medicine which is on the market in Montenegro and for which no marketing authorisation has been issued, the obligations referred to in paragraph 1 points 2 to 5 of this Article are taken over by the wholesaler which has been granted the import approval.

f.title: Do not refuse to consider ADR reports received electronically or otherwise from patients or HCPs
f.statement: The holder must not refuse to consider reports of suspected adverse reactions received electronically or by any other appropriate means from patients or health professionals.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek ne smije da odbije da razmotri prijave sumnji na neželjena dejstva primljene elektronskim putem ili na bilo koji drugi odgovarajući način od strane pacijenata ili zdravstvenih radnika.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder must not refuse to consider reports of suspected adverse reactions received electronically or in any other appropriate manner from patients or health professionals.

f.title: Report serious ADRs (any origin) to EudraVigilance within 15 days
f.statement: The holder must electronically report to EudraVigilance all suspected serious adverse reactions occurring in Montenegro, the EU or third countries within 15 days of becoming aware. Applies only from Montenegro's accession to the EU (Art 358).
f.applicability: Serious suspected ADRs, all origins; from EU accession (Art 358)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 15 days from awareness
rows.quote: ozbiljna neželjena dejstva koja su se ispoljila u Crnoj Gori, Evropskoj uniji ili trećim državama, u roku od 15 dana od dana saznanja;
rows.review_note: Review: Art 358 defers Art 157 to EU accession; confidence held below 90 for that reason. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: serious adverse reactions which occurred in Montenegro, the European Union or third countries, within 15 days from the day of becoming aware;

deadline_rule.applies_to: serious suspected ADRs (Montenegro, EU, third countries), from EU accession

f.title: Report non-serious ADRs (any origin) to EudraVigilance within 90 days
f.statement: The holder must electronically report to EudraVigilance all suspected non-serious adverse reactions occurring in Montenegro, the EU or third countries within 90 days of becoming aware. Applies only from Montenegro's accession to the EU (Art 358).
f.applicability: Non-serious suspected ADRs, all origins; from EU accession (Art 358)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 90 days from awareness
rows.quote: neželjena dejstva koja nijesu ozbiljna i koja su se ispoljila u Crnoj Gori, Evropskoj uniji ili trećim državama, u roku od 90 dana od dana saznanja.
rows.review_note: Review: as previous row. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: adverse reactions which are not serious and which occurred in Montenegro, the European Union or third countries, within 90 days from the day of becoming aware.

deadline_rule.applies_to: non-serious suspected ADRs (Montenegro, EU, third countries), from EU accession

f.title: Monitor all medical literature not covered by EMA's literature monitoring and report ADRs found
f.statement: For medicines containing active substances on EMA's list of monitored literature, the holder need not report to EudraVigilance the suspected adverse reactions described in that literature, but must monitor all other medical literature and report all suspected adverse reactions. Applies only from Montenegro's accession to the EU (Art 358).
f.applicability: From EU accession (Art 157 is listed in Art 358)
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Za ljekove koji sadrže aktivne supstance sa spiska literature koju prati EMA, koji sadrži medicinsku literaturu o neželjenim dejstvima za ljekove koji sadrže određene aktivne supstance, nosilac dozvole za lijek ne mora da prijavljuje u bazu podataka EudraVigilance sumnje na neželjena dejstva opisane u toj literaturi, ali je dužan da prati svu ostalu medicinsku literaturu i prijavljuje sve sumnje na neželjena dejstva.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For medicines containing active substances from the list of literature monitored by EMA, which contains medical literature on adverse reactions for medicines containing certain active substances, the marketing authorisation holder does not have to report to the EudraVigilance database suspected adverse reactions described in that literature, but is obliged to monitor all other medical literature and report all suspected adverse reactions.

f.title: Cooperate in detecting duplicate ADR reports
f.statement: The holder must cooperate with the Institute, EMA and EU Member States in detecting duplicates of suspected adverse reaction reports. Applies only from Montenegro's accession to the EU (Art 358).
f.processes: ICSR quality control; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da sarađuje sa Institutom. EMA i državama članicama Evropske unije u otkrivanju duplikata prijava sumnji na neželjena dejstva.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to cooperate with the Institute, EMA and the member states of the European Union in detecting duplicates of reports of suspected adverse reactions.

f.title: Pay the fee for the Institute's pharmacovigilance activities
f.statement: The holder must pay a fee for the pharmacovigilance activities that the Institute carries out under this law.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da plaća naknadu za sprovođenje aktivnosti farmakovigilance, koje Institut sprovodi u skladu sa ovim zakonom.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to pay a fee for the conduct of pharmacovigilance activities which the Institute carries out in accordance with this law.

f.title: Submit PSURs electronically with benefit-risk data, scientific evaluation and exposure data
f.statement: The holder must submit the PSUR electronically to the Institute (and to EMA from EU accession) containing: summaries of data relevant to benefits and risks, including results of all studies and their potential impact on the MA; a scientific evaluation of the benefit-risk balance based on all available data, including data from clinical trials in unauthorised indications and populations; and all data on sales volume and prescription volume held by the holder, including an estimate of the exposed population.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da, u elektronskoj formi, dostavi Institutu i EMA PSUR koji sadrži:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; the three content points follow. Submission to EMA applies from EU accession (Art 358: Art 159 'in the part relating to EMA'). Breaches are offences under Art 347(1)(56)-(57). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit to the Institute and EMA, in electronic form, a PSUR which contains:

f.title: Submit PSURs for generics, well-established use, traditional herbal and homeopathic products only when required
f.statement: For marketing authorisations for generic or bibliographic (well-established use) applications, registered traditional herbal medicines and registered homeopathic medicines, the holder submits PSURs to the Institute only where this is set as an obligation in the MA, or at the request of the Institute (and EMA) based on pharmacovigilance data or the lack of PSURs for an active substance.
f.applicability: Generic, well-established use, traditional herbal and homeopathic products
f.exceptions: PSUR still required where it is an MA condition or on request.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Izuzetno od stava 1 ovog člana, za dozvole za lijek koje su izdate za generičke ili bibliografske aplikacije, registraciju tradicionalnih biljnih ljekova i registraciju homeopatskih ljekova, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da dostavi Institutu PSUR, u sljedećim slučajevima:
rows.review_note: Review: level Permitted because the row records the relief from routine PSURs; the residual duty is conditional. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: By way of exception to paragraph 1 of this Article, for marketing authorisations issued for generic or bibliographic applications, registration of traditional herbal medicines and registration of homeopathic medicines, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit a PSUR to the Institute in the following cases:

f.title: Follow EURD-list PSUR frequencies and keep aligned with EU reference dates via variations
f.statement: The Institute sets the PSUR submission frequency in line with the EURD list when granting the MA; EURD frequencies apply to products authorised by the Institute and bind holders. Holders must align with the published EU reference dates and keep that alignment continuously by submitting variations. PSUR submission dates are calculated from the MA grant date.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Učestalosti utvrđene na EURD listi primjenjuju se na ljekove za koje je dozvolu za lijek izdao Institut i obavezujuće su za nosioce dozvole za lijek. Nosioci dozvole za lijek dužni su da budu usklađeni sa objavljenim referentnim datumima Evropske unije i da to usklađivanje održavaju u kontinuitetu, podnošenjem zahtjeva za varijacije.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The frequencies established in the EURD list apply to medicines for which the marketing authorisation was issued by the Institute and are binding on marketing authorisation holders. Marketing authorisation holders are obliged to be aligned with the published European Union reference dates and to maintain that alignment continuously by submitting variation applications.

f.title: Optionally request a change of EURD-list PSUR frequency on defined grounds
f.statement: The holder may request the setting or change of the frequencies on the EURD list for reasons of protection of public health, avoiding duplication of assessment, or achieving international harmonisation.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek može zahtijevati utvrđivanje ili izmjene učestalosti utvrđenih na EURD listi iz sljedećih razloga:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; three grounds follow. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder may request the establishment or amendment of the frequencies established in the EURD list for the following reasons:

f.title: For pre-July-2012 products without set PSUR dates, submit PSURs on request or on the default 6-month/annual/3-year cycle
f.statement: For medicines authorised before 21 July 2012 whose PSUR frequency and dates are not set in the MA conditions, holders must submit PSURs without delay on request, or: (1) if not yet marketed, at least every six months after authorisation until marketing; (2) if marketed, at least every six months during the first two years after first marketing, once a year for the following two years, and every three years thereafter. This applies until another frequency is set in the MA or under the EURD list.
f.applicability: Medicines authorised before 21 July 2012 without PSUR frequency/dates in the MA conditions

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Za ljekove za koje je izdata dozvola za lijek prije 21. jula 2012. godine i za koje učestalost i datumi dostavljanja PSUR nijesu određeni u uslovima u dozvoli za lijek, nosioci dozvole za lijek dužni su da dostavljaju PSUR, bez odlaganja na zahtjev Instituta, odnosno u skladu sa sljedećim rokovima, ako:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; cycle summarised from points 1-2. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For medicines for which the marketing authorisation was issued before 21 July 2012 and for which the frequency and dates of PSUR submission are not determined in the conditions of the marketing authorisation, marketing authorisation holders are obliged to submit PSURs without delay at the request of the Institute, or in accordance with the following deadlines, if:

f.title: Notify the Institute and EMA of new or changed risks or benefit-risk changes
f.statement: If the holder determines that there are new risks, that risks have changed, or that they affect the benefit-risk balance, it must inform the Institute and EMA. Applies only from Montenegro's accession to the EU (Art 358).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Ako nosilac dozvole za lijek utvrdi da postoje novi rizici ili da su se rizici promijenili, odnosno da utiču na odnos koristi i rizika, dužan je da o tome obavijesti Institut i EMA.
rows.review_note: Review: deferred to EU accession; the domestic duty to report benefit-risk information without delay (Art 156(1)(2)) applies now. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the marketing authorisation holder determines that there are new risks or that risks have changed, or that they affect the benefit-risk balance, it is obliged to inform the Institute and EMA thereof.

f.title: Run non-interventional PASS at own cost and never to promote the medicine
f.statement: The holder may conduct non-interventional PASS collecting safety data from patients and health professionals, on its own initiative or at the Institute's request. The holder bears the costs; the study must not be conducted so as to promote use of the medicine; payment of health professionals is limited to compensation for time and expenses.
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Troškove sprovođenja neintervencijske PASS snosi nosilac dozvole za lijek. Neintervencijska PASS ne smije da se sprovodi tako da se promoviše upotreba lijeka. Naknada zdravstvenom radniku za učestvovanje u neintervencijskim PASS ograničena je na naknadu za utrošeno vrijeme i nastale troškove.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The costs of conducting a non-interventional PASS are borne by the marketing authorisation holder. A non-interventional PASS must not be conducted in a way that promotes the use of the medicine. Compensation to a health professional for participation in non-interventional PASS is limited to compensation for time spent and expenses incurred.

f.title: Monitor PASS data and report new benefit-risk information while the study runs
f.statement: During a non-interventional PASS, the holder must monitor the data collected and assess their impact on the benefit-risk balance, and must inform the Institute and the competent authority of the EU Member State where the MA was granted of any new information that may affect the benefit-risk balance, and take appropriate measures.
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Tokom sprovođenja neintervencijske PASS, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da prati prikupljene podatke i procijeni njihov uticaj na odnos koristi i rizika ispitivanog lijeka. Nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da obavijesti Institut i nadležno tijelo države članice Evropske unije u kojoj je izdata dozvola za lijek o svakoj novoj informaciji koja može da utiče na odnos koristi i rizika od primjene lijeka, kao i da preduzme odgovarajuće mjere.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: During the conduct of a non-interventional PASS, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to monitor the collected data and assess their impact on the benefit-risk balance of the medicine under study. The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to inform the Institute and the competent body of the EU member state in which the marketing authorisation was issued of any new information which may affect the benefit-risk balance of the use of the medicine, and to take appropriate measures.

f.title: Submit the final PASS report within 12 months of end of data collection
f.statement: The holder must submit the final report of a non-interventional PASS to the Institute within 12 months of the end of data collection. The Institute may also require the protocol and progress reports. This does not affect the duty to present PASS results in PSURs.
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.deadline: 12 months from the end of data collection
rows.quote: Završni izvještaj neintervencijske PASS, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da dostavi Institutu u roku od 12 mjeseci od završetka prikupljanja podataka.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit the final report of a non-interventional PASS to the Institute within 12 months from the end of data collection.

f.title: For Montenegro-only imposed PASS, obtain written approval of the draft protocol before starting
f.statement: For non-interventional PASS conducted only in Montenegro under Article 61 (imposed), the holder must submit the draft protocol to the Institute; the study may start only after the Institute's written approval (the Institute responds within 60 days). All substantial amendments to the protocol must be submitted to the Institute before implementation.
f.applicability: Imposed non-interventional PASS conducted only in Montenegro
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Za neintervencijske PASS koje se sprovode samo u Crnoj Gori u skladu sa članom 61 ovog zakona, nosilac dozvole za lijek dužan je da dostavi nacrt protokola Institutu. Sprovođenje neintervencijske PASS može da započne nakon davanja pisanog odobrenja od strane Instituta.
rows.review_note: Review: substantial-amendment duty from paragraph 4 of the same article included. Multi-country PRAC-led PASS (Art 165) apply only from EU accession and are not curated separately. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For non-interventional PASS which are conducted only in Montenegro in accordance with Article 61 of this law, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit the draft protocol to the Institute. The conduct of the non-interventional PASS may begin after the written approval is given by the Institute.

f.title: Allow inspection of premises, records, documents and the PSMF, including contracted PV parties
f.statement: Pharmaceutical inspectors are authorised to inspect the premises, records, documents and PSMF of the marketing authorisation holder and of any other party engaged by the holder for pharmacovigilance activities; after inspection the Institute reports whether the holder complies with the pharmacovigilance provisions and GVP. Where the holder is found not to comply with the system described in the PSMF, the Institute warns the holder and gives it the opportunity to comment.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: za nadzor prostora, zapisa, dokumenata i PSMF nosioca dozvole za lijek, kao i drugog lica koje je angažovao nosilac dozvole za lijek za obavljanje aktivnosti iz oblasti farmakovigilance;
rows.review_note: Review: inspector power, kept because MAH and its PV contractors must be inspection-ready. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: for supervision of the premises, records, documents and PSMF of the marketing authorisation holder, as well as of another person engaged by the marketing authorisation holder to perform pharmacovigilance activities;

f.title: Note that breaches of PV duties are offences fined EUR 5,000-20,000
f.statement: A legal entity is fined EUR 5,000 to 20,000 for offences including: not submitting a PSUR for a conditional MA; not operating a PV system with scientific evaluation; not auditing the PV system and recording findings in the PSMF with corrective actions; not maintaining or providing the PSMF; not operating an RMS for each product; not monitoring outcomes of risk minimisation measures; not updating the RMS; not keeping records of domestic suspected ADRs; not collecting and promptly submitting benefit-risk information; not submitting PSURs with the required content.
f.clause: XX. Kaznene odredbe, Član 347, stav 1, tač. 2 i 48-57

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Novčanom kaznom u iznosu od 5.000 eura do 20.000 eura kazniće se za prekršaj pravno lice, ako:
rows.location: XX. Kaznene odredbe, Član 347, stav 1, tač. 2 i 48-57
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; the PV-related points listed are 2 and 48-57. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: A legal entity shall be fined for an offence in the amount of EUR 5,000 to EUR 20,000 if it:

f.title: Notify a temporary halt or early termination for benefit-risk reasons within 15 days
f.statement: The sponsor or its representative must notify the Institute of a temporary halt or early termination of a clinical trial due to a change in the benefit-risk balance without undue delay and at the latest 15 days from the date of the halt or termination, with the reasons and follow-up measures. Restarting the trial after such a halt is a substantial modification.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: Without undue delay, at the latest 15 days from the halt/termination
rows.quote: Sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik dužan je da obavijesti Institut o privremenoj obustavi ili prijevremenom završetku kliničkog ispitivanja zbog promjene odnosa koristi i rizika bez nepotrebnog odlaganja, a najkasnije 15 dana od dana privremene obustave ili prijevremenog završetka, sa obrazloženjem i mjerama praćenja.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or its representative is obliged to notify the Institute of the temporary halt or early termination of the clinical trial due to a change in the benefit-risk balance without undue delay, and at the latest 15 days from the day of the temporary halt or early termination, with the reasons and follow-up measures.

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana privremene obustave ili prijevremenog završetka
deadline_rule.applies_to: temporary halt or early termination for benefit-risk reasons

f.title: Retain responsibility for subject safety when delegating sponsor duties
f.statement: The sponsor may delegate some or all of its duties by written contract to another person or organisation, but remains responsible, in particular for the safety of subjects and the reliability and robustness of trial data.
f.processes: Partner & vendor oversight; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (nosilac dozvole za lijek)
rows.quote: Sponzor može pisanim ugovorom povjeriti pojedine ili sve svoje obaveze drugom pravnom ili fizičkom licu, instituciji ili organizaciji, pri čemu se ne oslobađa od odgovornosti, naročito u pogledu bezbjednosti ispitanika, kao i pouzdanosti i vjerodostojnosti podataka dobijenih u kliničkom ispitivanju.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor may by written contract entrust some or all of its obligations to another legal or natural person, institution or organisation, without being released from responsibility, in particular as regards the safety of subjects and the reliability and credibility of the data obtained in the clinical trial.

f.title: Investigators: record AEs and report SAEs to the sponsor within 24 hours
f.statement: The investigator must record adverse events or laboratory abnormalities identified in the protocol as critical to safety evaluation and report them to the sponsor as the protocol requires; record all adverse events unless the protocol provides otherwise and report all serious adverse events to the sponsor; notify the sponsor of serious adverse events without undue delay and at the latest within 24 hours of becoming aware, unless the protocol states that immediate reporting is not required for certain events, and provide follow-up reports where needed; and notify the sponsor without undue delay of serious adverse events possibly related to the trial medicine that occur after the end of the trial in subjects the investigator treated.
f.exceptions: Events for which the protocol states that immediate reporting is not required.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Investigator (ispitivač)
rows.deadline: Without undue delay, at the latest 24 hours from awareness
rows.quote: obavijesti sponzora, odnosno njegov predstavnika, bez nepotrebnog odlaganja, a najkasnije u roku od 24 časa od saznanja za ozbiljni neželjeni događaj, osim ako za određene neželjene događaje protokolom kliničkog ispitivanja nije utvrđeno da hitno izvještavanje nije potrebno,
rows.review_note: Review: points 1, 2 and 4 summarised with the 24-hour rule from point 3. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: notify the sponsor or its representative, without undue delay, and at the latest within 24 hours of becoming aware of the serious adverse event, unless for certain adverse events the clinical trial protocol has established that urgent reporting is not required,

deadline_rule.clock_start: od saznanja za ozbiljni neželjeni događaj

f.title: Keep detailed records of all adverse events reported by investigators
f.statement: The sponsor or its representative must keep detailed records of all adverse events reported by the investigator.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.quote: Sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik dužan je da vodi detaljnu evidenciju o svim neželjenim događajima koje je prijavio ispitivač.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or its representative is obliged to keep detailed records of all adverse events reported by the investigator.

f.title: Report to the Institute all SUSARs in the trial, related foreign-trial SUSARs, and post-trial SUSARs
f.statement: The sponsor or its representative must report to the Institute all relevant information on: (1) all SUSARs to investigational medicines occurring during the trial, whether at a site in Montenegro, the EU or a third country; (2) all SUSARs related to the same active substance, regardless of form, strength or indication, occurring in a trial conducted exclusively outside Montenegro if sponsored by the same sponsor or by a sponsor in the same parent company or co-developing the medicine under a formal agreement (supplying the product or safety information to a future MAH is not co-development); (3) all SUSARs in any subject identified or becoming known to the sponsor after the end of the trial.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.quote: Sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik dužan je da prijavi Institutu sve relevantne informacije o sumnji na neočekivana ozbiljna neželjena dejstva, i to:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; three categories summarised. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or its representative is obliged to report to the Institute all relevant information on suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions, namely:

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 7 days of awareness
f.statement: Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs are reported to the Institute as soon as possible and at the latest within seven days of the sponsor becoming aware of the reaction.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: As soon as possible, at the latest 7 days from awareness
rows.quote: u slučaju smrtonosnih ili po život opasnih sumnji na neočekivano ozbiljno neželjeno dejstvo, što je moguće prije, a najkasnije u roku od sedam dana od dana saznanja za neželjeno dejstvo;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: in the case of fatal or life-threatening suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions, as soon as possible, and at the latest within seven days from the day of becoming aware of the adverse reaction;

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana saznanja za neželjeno dejstvo

f.title: Report other SUSARs within 15 days of awareness
f.statement: SUSARs that are not fatal and not life-threatening are reported to the Institute within 15 days of the sponsor becoming aware of the reaction.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: 15 days from awareness
rows.quote: u slučaju neželjenog dejstva koje nema smrtni ishod ili sumnje na ozbiljno neželjeno dejstvo koje nije opasno po život, u roku od 15 dana od dana saznanja za neželjeno dejstvo;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: in the case of an adverse reaction which has no fatal outcome or a suspected serious adverse reaction which is not life-threatening, within 15 days from the day of becoming aware of the adverse reaction;

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana saznanja za neželjeno dejstvo

f.title: Report SUSARs upgraded to fatal or life-threatening within 7 days of learning this
f.statement: For a SUSAR initially considered non-fatal and not life-threatening that turns out to be fatal or life-threatening, the sponsor reports as soon as possible and at the latest seven days from becoming aware that the reaction was fatal or life-threatening. Where needed for timely reporting, an initial incomplete report may be submitted, followed by a complete report.
f.applicability: SUSARs upgraded to fatal or life-threatening

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: As soon as possible, at the latest 7 days from awareness of the upgrade
rows.quote: u slučaju sumnji na neočekivano ozbiljno neželjeno dejstvo za koje se prvobitno smatralo da nema smrtni ishod ili da nije opasno po život, a za koje se ispostavi da jeste smrtonosno ili opasno po život, što je moguće prije, a najkasnije sedam dana od dana saznanja da je neželjeno dejstvo imalo smrtni ishod ili bilo opasno po život.
rows.review_note: Review: initial-incomplete-report permission (paragraph 3) added to the statement. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: in the case of a suspected unexpected serious adverse reaction which was initially considered not to have a fatal outcome or not to be life-threatening, but which turns out to be fatal or life-threatening, as soon as possible, and at the latest seven days from the day of becoming aware that the adverse reaction had a fatal outcome or was life-threatening.

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana saznanja da je neželjeno dejstvo imalo smrtni ishod ili bilo opasno po život
deadline_rule.applies_to: SUSARs upgraded to fatal or life-threatening

f.title: Submit an annual safety report for each investigational medicine
f.statement: The sponsor or its representative must submit to the Institute an annual report on the safety of each investigational medicine (other than placebo) used in trials it sponsors; one report may cover all investigational medicines of a trial if the protocol provides for it; the report contains only aggregated and anonymised data; the reporting period runs from the first trial authorisation (in the first country) to the end of the trial (in the last country).

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: Annually
rows.quote: Sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik dužan je da podnese Institutu godišnji izvještaj o bezbjednosti svakog ispitivanog lijeka, osim placeba, koji se koristi u kliničkom ispitivanju čiji je sponzor.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or its representative is obliged to submit to the Institute an annual report on the safety of each investigational medicine, other than placebo, used in the clinical trial of which it is the sponsor.

f.title: Report safety of auxiliary medicines under the marketed-product PV rules
f.statement: Safety reporting for auxiliary medicinal products used in a clinical trial follows the provisions of this law on recording, reporting and assessment of pharmacovigilance data.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.quote: Izvještavanje o bezbjednosti dodatnih ljekova koji se koriste u kliničkom ispitivanju, sprovodi se u skladu sa odredbama ovog zakona koje se odnose na pitanja evidencije, prijavljivanja i procjene podataka u farmakovigilanci.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Safety reporting on auxiliary medicines used in a clinical trial is carried out in accordance with the provisions of this law relating to recording, reporting and assessment of data in pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Report serious breaches of the law or protocol within 7 days
f.statement: The sponsor or its representative must notify the Institute of a serious breach of this law or of the protocol applicable at the time without undue delay and at the latest seven days after becoming aware of it. A serious breach is one likely to affect to a significant degree the safety and rights of subjects or the reliability and robustness of trial data.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: Without undue delay, at the latest 7 days after becoming aware
rows.quote: Sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik dužan je da obavijesti Institut o ozbiljnom kršenju odredaba ovog zakona ili protokola kliničkog ispitivanja koji se primjenjuje u trenutku kršenja, bez nepotrebnog odlaganja, a najkasnije sedam dana nakon saznanja o kršenju.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or its representative is obliged to notify the Institute of a serious breach of the provisions of this law or of the clinical trial protocol applicable at the time of the breach, without undue delay, and at the latest seven days after becoming aware of the breach.

f.title: Notify unexpected events affecting the trial benefit-risk balance within 15 days
f.statement: The sponsor or its representative must notify the Institute of all unexpected events affecting the benefit-risk balance of the trial that are not SUSARs, without undue delay and at the latest 15 days from the date the sponsor became aware of the event.

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative (sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik)
rows.deadline: Without undue delay, at the latest 15 days from awareness
rows.quote: Sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik dužan je da obavijesti Institut o svim neočekivanim događajima koji utiču na odnos koristi i rizika kliničkog ispitivanja, ali koji nijesu sumnja na neočekivana ozbiljna neželjena dejstva iz člana 193 ovog zakona, bez nepotrebnog odlaganja, a najkasnije 15 dana od dana kad je sponzor saznao za događaj.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or its representative is obliged to notify the Institute of all unexpected events which affect the benefit-risk balance of the clinical trial but which are not suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions referred to in Article 193 of this law, without undue delay, and at the latest 15 days from the day the sponsor became aware of the event.

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana kad je sponzor saznao za događaj

f.title: Submit third-country inspection reports on the trial, with translation on request
f.statement: The sponsor must submit to the Institute all reports of inspections by competent authorities of third countries relating to the clinical trial and, at the Institute's request, a translation of the report or its summary into Montenegrin.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.actor: Sponsor
rows.quote: Sponzor je dužan da Institutu dostavi sve izvještaje o izvršenim inspekcijama nadležnih organa trećih država koji se odnose na kliničko ispitivanje, a, na zahtjev Instituta, dužan je da dostavi i prevod izvještaja ili njegovog sažetka na crnogorski jezik.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor is obliged to submit to the Institute all reports on inspections carried out by competent authorities of third countries relating to the clinical trial, and, at the request of the Institute, is obliged to submit a translation of the report or its summary into the Montenegrin language.

f.title: Take urgent safety measures and notify them within 7 days
f.statement: Where an unexpected event is likely to seriously affect the benefit-risk balance, the sponsor or its representative and the investigator must take appropriate urgent safety measures to protect subjects. The sponsor must notify the event and the measures taken without undue delay and at the latest within seven days of taking the measures (the text names the competent EU Member States as recipients).

rows.actor: Sponsor or its representative and investigator
rows.deadline: Without undue delay, at the latest 7 days from taking the measures
rows.quote: Ako je vjerovatno da će neočekivani događaj ozbiljno uticati na odnos koristi i rizika, sponzor, odnosno njegov predstavnik i ispitivač dužni su da preduzmu odgovarajuće hitne bezbjednosne mjere kako bi zaštitili ispitanike. Sponzor je dužan da o događaju iz stava 5 ovog člana i preduzetim mjerama obavijesti nadležne države članice Evropske unije, bez nepotrebnog odlaganja, a najkasnije u roku od sedam dana od dana preduzimanja mjera.
rows.review_note: Review: the notification recipient in paragraph 6 is 'competent EU Member States' (not the Institute) and Art 197 is not listed in Art 358; flagged for SME review. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force ('dužan je' = shall) and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If an unexpected event is likely to seriously affect the benefit-risk balance, the sponsor or its representative and the investigator are obliged to take appropriate urgent safety measures to protect the subjects. The sponsor is obliged to notify the competent member states of the European Union of the event referred to in paragraph 5 of this Article and the measures taken, without undue delay, and at the latest within seven days from the day the measures were taken.

dates.title: Montenegro Law on Medicines 2026: enters into force
dates.scope: All addressees of the law (MAHs, sponsors, wholesalers, manufacturers); provisions listed in Art 358 apply only from EU accession
dates.quote: Ovaj zakon stupa na snagu osmog dana od dana objavljivanja u "Službenom listu Crne Gore".
dates.quote_en: This law enters into force on the eighth day from the day of publication in the Official Gazette of Montenegro.
dates.location: XXI. Prelazne i završne odredbe, Član 360

dates.title: Montenegro Law on Medicines 2026: MAHs, manufacturers, wholesalers and importers must comply
dates.scope: Manufacturers seated in Montenegro, wholesalers, importers and marketing authorisation holders: alignment of their operations with the law and its implementing regulations
dates.quote: Proizvođači sa sjedištem u Crnoj Gori, veleprodaje, uvoznici i nosioci dozvole za lijek dužni su da svoje poslovanje usklade sa odredbama ovog zakona i propisima donijetim za njegovo sprovođenje u roku od 24 mjeseca od dana stupanja na snagu ovog zakona.
dates.quote_en: Manufacturers seated in Montenegro, wholesalers, importers and marketing authorisation holders are obliged to align their operations with the provisions of this law and the regulations adopted for its implementation within 24 months from the day this law enters into force.
